title: Add demo-tenant dashboard exports (latency/cost/errors) + import docs
author: Chloe Martin
description:
Context: The Standard Demo v1 work needs dashboards that are stable and fast to re-import into the demo tenant, with consistent panel naming and variables so SEs/AEs can follow a single clickpath during live demos.

This PR adds prebuilt dashboard JSON exports for the demo tenant (Latency, Cost/Usage, Errors/Throttling) and documents the recommended import + verification steps. The exports are designed to be safe for live demos: no customer identifiers, no raw prompts/responses, and all queries scoped to the demo tenant + last 30/60 minutes by default.

What’s included: (1) Dashboard exports under dashboards/demo-tenant/ with variables for tenant_id, route_id, model_id, and region. (2) A minimal schema/lint check to catch missing required tags/templating variables before merge. (3) Import instructions (Console UI + CLI path) and a short pre-demo verification checklist.

Notes/constraints: These are Console dashboard exports (not Grafana). Panel queries rely on the standard metrics emitted by the gateway/runtime: request_count, http_5xx, http_429, ttft_ms, e2e_latency_ms, tokens_in/out, cost_usd, cache_hit_rate, and batch_size. If we change metric names in the platform, we need to update exports + the lint allowlist together.

Demo tenant alignment: Targets the demo-tenant runbook requirements (ENG-4922) and addresses a common failure mode from dry runs where imported dashboards were missing panels due to stale export format (INT-782).

illustrative_snippet:
Example variable contract used by all demo-tenant dashboards:
- ${tenant_id}: required, defaults to "demo-tenant"
- ${route_id}: optional, defaults to "*"
- ${model_id}: optional, defaults to "*"
- ${region}: optional, defaults to "*"

Latency dashboard panels (high level):
- Time to First Token (p50/p95)
- End-to-end latency (p50/p95)
- Tokens/sec (output)
- Cache hit rate
- Batch size distribution (last 15m)

Errors/Throttling panels (high level):
- 5xx rate + counts
- 429 throttles (quota/rate-limit)
- Streaming disconnects (by reason code)
- Top routes by error volume

Chloe Martin (author): Added required tags to all three dashboards + updated dashboard_lint.py to fail if tags are missing. Also normalized panel titles to use p50/p95.

Logan Wright (review): Can we add a panel that directly supports the live story on cost controls? Something like "Cost per 1K output tokens" and a quick view that splits cached vs non-cached requests.

Chloe Martin (author): Added Cost per 1K output tokens (rolling 5m) and a cached vs non-cached request share panel. Both are behind route_id/model_id filters.

Sean Gallagher (review): Please keep the default time range tight for demos; last 60m is OK but make sure the dashboards load quickly. Also add a pre-demo checklist section: verify ingestion is live, no data gaps.

Rafael Mendes (review): Import steps should include the exact Console clickpath and what to do if panels are missing. We’ve seen "partial import" issues.

Chloe Martin (author): Added a troubleshooting section: re-import with "overwrite", confirm tenant_id variable is set, and validate export version. Also referenced INT-782 symptoms.
